cells.quote: A benchmarking analysis of the xOrder method on the institution's data showed intractable scaling: "runtime scaling of approximately 𝑛2.36," extrapolating to months of computation and over one hundred gigabytes of memory for one domestic-international comparison. The method is also formally defined only for binary sensitive attributes, while two of the study's three attributes are not binary.
